name: New Balance Uruguay
description: Online store of New Balance in Uruguay. Sells footwear, clothing and accessories such as bags, backpacks and socks for men, women and children. Ships to the whole country and offers free store pickup.
description_es: Tienda online de New Balance en Uruguay. Vende calzado, indumentaria y accesorios como bolsos, mochilas y medias para hombre, mujer y niños. Envía a todo el país y ofrece retiro gratis en sucursal.

ships_to.notes: Nationwide delivery by UES (Montevideo 24 business hours; 72 business hours elsewhere in the country), per the store's shipping page.

fulfillment.pickup_notes: Free pickup at its stores with prior coordination; ready within 72 business hours.
